Research direction · 02

AI Governance: Data Safety & Content Integrity

Training data shape a model long before it reaches users. We investigate poisoning, bias, and privacy leakage in multimodal and generative systems, and develop ways to evaluate and reduce these risks.

Data poisoningAlgorithmic fairnessPrivacy protectionData governance

Four research directions

  4. 04Embodied Intelligence

Research focus

What we study.

01

Poisoning & backdoors

Test how manipulated training examples affect multimodal models and downstream foundation-model tasks.

02

Bias & fair generation

Examine fairness in text-to-image generation and methods for reducing disparities in generated outputs.

03

Privacy-preserving adaptation

Study membership-inference and model-inversion risks in model adaptation and federated learning.
